desc:
Welcome to Steal the Bobo! 🐻

How to Play:
• Buy Bobos as they walk down the path!🛒
• Race your rivals and snipe a Bobo before it reaches their base!⚡
• Break into other players' bases and grab their Bobos!🔓
• Lock your base to protect your loot from thieves!🔒
• Collect tons of cash from your Bobos💸
• Upgrade your characters to earn even more🔥
• Expand your plot to unlock extra slots🏗️
• Trade & gift Bobos with friends to grow together!🎁
• Complete your Index to unlock cash boosts & base colors!📖
• But watch out... rivals can rob YOUR base too!🚨

Remember, your Bobos earn cash even while you're offline!⏰
